records.name: mainType
records.mapping: omit:ECharts reads mainType from the SeriesModel class, not from options.

records.name: blendMode
records.noEffect: ECharts applies blendMode to the elements present at render; words are drawn after the series render.

records.name: cursor
records.noEffect: WordCloudView never sets the cursor of a word; ZRender shows its default pointer.

records.name: select
records.mapping: omit:WordCloudView creates only the emphasis and blur states; ECharts applies select styles only to elements that have a select state.

records.name: animationThreshold
records.mapping: omit:WordCloudView reads animation directly for word state transitions; the data count threshold never applies.

records.name: animationDuration
records.mapping: omit:WordCloudView adds words without enter or update animations, so series animation timing never reaches them.
